title: Cross-Server Arena locks its challenge buttons until opponents load
summary: No text, art or player-facing config changed in this version. The only changes are to client screens: the Cross-Server Arena challenge list now locks its buttons until the newest opponent list has arrived, and an opponent's displayed power is read from a different source.
highlights: Cross-Server Arena: the challenge, detail and refresh buttons stay greyed out until the latest opponent list comes back, so a stale opponent can no longer be entered.
Cross-Server Arena: an opponent's displayed power now comes from their base info rather than their ranking record.
